$comment: First-load JavaScript per route, gzip KB, from `pnpm build` (polyfills excluded: legacy browsers only). Enforced by bin/check-budgets.mjs as a hard CI gate. Next 16 + React 19 alone are ~143 KB. Raise a budget only with a reason in the commit message. `lazy` budgets the 3D model viewer (Babylon.js), which must never be in a route's first load: `modelViewer` is what opening it downloads before a format loader (measured 282 KB), `modelViewerReachable` everything it can load on demand, an over-counting ceiling (measured 1602 KB).
